basic_info.description: Beautiful vacant duplex with hill views, 2 bedroom 1 bathroom each. Freshly repainted inside and out. The floors have been refinished, and new light fixtures add a modern touch. You can enjoy it as it is or customize it further to match your vision. Live in one unit and rent out the other for additional income or use both as a fantastic investment opportunity. This property also lends itself perfectly to multi-generational living, offering privacy and flexibility while keeping loved ones close. It also could be a flipping opportunity for contractors and developers with a vision. Large yard, 2 car-garage and ample storage areas. Conveniently located near the 280 Freeway, public transportation, Manila Market, and the shops and restaurants along Mission Street. This property offers both comfort and accessibility.
